title: A rectifiable triple defines a current τ(M, θ, ξ) (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1)
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) with IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ, there is a current R ∈ D_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k) with R(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω = ∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵏ(x) for every ω ∈ D^k(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → ∃ R : GeometricCurrentOn U k, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, R ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω
